MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV Stick feels like a useful next purchase because it could add streaming to my older Samsung TV, provided the connections are compatible.",
    "That suggestion fits my pattern of buying accessories that give equipment I already own a practical new use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My tripods, memory cards and lens cap support photography; they do not indicate that I need security cameras or a video doorbell.",
    "Smart speakers, a smart display and a smart plug do not solve a current need for me. My tablet, power strips and car accessories were bought for specific practical purposes.",
    "The 4K streaming sticks offer capabilities my listed 720p TV cannot display, so I would choose the HD option for my current setup."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a whole range of Alexa devices, although I bought accessories to support the tablet itself.",
    "Broad connections such as cameras, car electronics and power accessories seem to have outweighed the different purposes those purchases served."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Exact compatibility matters to me: my history includes a Fire 7 case, specific charging connectors and a 72mm lens cap.",
    "My repeated purchases of storage, cables, mounts and protective holders suggest ongoing needs around maintaining and using existing equipment.",
    "The capabilities of devices I already own matter: my 720p TV gives me a reason to consider HD streaming, while my Fire tablet already meets my portable screen needs."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in useful electronics accessories but stretched that into an unsupported interest in home automation and monitoring."
}
